headline.purpose: Section headings; h1-h3 resolve here automatically.

title.purpose: Card titles, list item primary text.

body.purpose: Default readable text and form controls (pinned to 16px).

brand.purpose: Wordmark only -- never used for UI copy.

shadows.name: glass-card
shadows.value: 0 24px 60px -32px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 55%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent)

motion.name: spring-tap
motion.purpose: Default press/hover spring for every tappable primitive.

motion.name: ease-signature
motion.purpose: CSS-side equivalent used across rise/sheet/pressable/pin transitions.

motion.name: radar-pulse
motion.purpose: Expanding ring for live-presence pins; same grammar as skeleton sheen.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button: filled Evergreen Signal, springy press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 26px; background: oklch(0.44 0.09 168); color: oklch(0.985 0.006 95); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.09 168); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent fill, hairline-free neutral border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.01 70 / 0.16); border-radius: 26px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.22 0.012 70); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.01 95); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Semantic status indicator; tinted background at low opacity over full-strength text.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pill-good { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.13 155) 15%, transparent); color: oklch(0.55 0.13 155); } .ds-pill-accent { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.44 0.09 168) 12%, transparent); color: oklch(0.44 0.09 168); }

components.name: Card (Frosted)
components.description: Default panel: blur + hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(1 0 0) 74%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.22 0.012 70) 9%, transparent); border-radius: 28px; padding: 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field: rounded, hairline border, 16px text to avoid iOS zoom.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.01 70 / 0.16); background: oklch(0.985 0.006 95); color: oklch(0.22 0.012 70); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.44 0.09 168) 60%, transparent); }

components.name: Glass Nav Pill
components.description: Floating capsule chrome used for the top bar, bottom tab bar, and status pills -- the app's one floating-glass language.
components.css: .ds-glass-pill { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.03); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(190%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(190%); padding: 8px 14px; }

components.name: Radar Avatar Pin
components.description: Live-presence map marker: Evergreen-ringed avatar with an expanding pulse ring.
components.css: .ds-avatar-pin { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; } .ds-avatar-pulse { position: absolute; inset: -6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.44 0.09 168) 28%, transparent); animation: ds-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite; } .ds-avatar-face { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.22 0.01 260); border: 2.5px solid oklch(0.44 0.09 168); color: #fafafa; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { transform: scale(0.7); opacity: 0.7; } 100% { transform: scale(1.7); opacity: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Syncly reads as a live-signal instrument wearing warm, ink-on-paper calm during the day and going full glass-and-glow after dark. The name isn't decorative: the radar pulse that animates a friend's live location on the map is the same visual grammar -- a soft ring expanding from a solid core -- that shows up as loading skeleton sheens, presence indicators, and the "S" glyph at the center of the app mark. Everything floats: navigation, search, and status live in frosted glass capsules that sit with margin above the content rather than fusing to the screen edge, because the product's real subject (the map, the plan, the group) should always show through.

The system is calm, trustworthy, and quietly premium rather than loud or gamified -- it has to read as safe to a parent glancing at the Family Hub and as genuinely nice to use for a teen coordinating a Friday night. Color discipline does the work here: one confident evergreen carries almost the entire system, one warm ember accent appears only as a rare spark. Depth is deliberate rather than decorative -- flat where structure needs to read clearly, frosted where content needs to breathe underneath, and only truly "lifted" where a control needs to visibly float over live map or page content.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-paper light mode, near-black "Apple-style" dark mode -- both real, tuned themes, not a light mode with inverted values.
One confident accent (evergreen), one rare spark (amber) -- never treated as co-equal.
Floating glass chrome for navigation and controls; structural content stays flat or frosted.
Every border, divider, and skeleton is the ink color at low opacity, never a separate gray token.
Motion is spring-physical (bounce, lift, haptic tap) everywhere a control responds to touch.

rules.name: The Warm Ember Rule
rules.body: Amber is a rare spark, not a second primary. Reserve it for a glow, a celebration moment, or a single accent pill per screen -- if amber is competing with Evergreen Signal for attention anywhere, that's a bug, not a choice.

rules.name: The Ink-Mix Rule
rules.body: Every border, divider, skeleton background, and scrollbar thumb is color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) N%, transparent) at some low percentage -- never a standalone gray hex.

rules.name: The Sixteen Rule
rules.body: No form input renders below 16px, ever -- it's what stops iOS from zooming the whole page on focus.

rules.name: The Inset Chrome Rule
rules.body: Navigation and floating controls never sit edge-to-edge. They're capsules with margin so the content behind is always visible around them.

rules.name: The No-Shadow-On-Frost Rule
rules.body: The surface/Card tier never gets a box-shadow. If a panel needs to visually separate, make it a flat card-surface or a true floating glass-card instead.

rules.name: The Full-Or-Structural Rule
rules.body: Radius is either rounded-full (anything that floats or is a pill/badge/circular control) or a structural step (xl through 3xl). Nothing in between.

dos: Do derive every border, divider, skeleton fill, and scrollbar color from color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) N%, transparent) rather than a standalone gray.
Do keep floating chrome (nav, search, status pills, map controls) inset from the screen edge with visible margin, in glass-pill/glass-card, never edge-to-edge or opaque.
Do pair every tappable control with a spring press/hover animation and a haptic tap -- a static button in this system reads as broken, not restrained.
Do reserve rounded-full for anything that floats, is a pill, or is circular; use the structural radius steps (xl-3xl) for containers.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-reduced-transparency for every new motion or glass surface.
Do keep Evergreen Signal as the only color doing real "this is interactive/primary" work across the app.
donts: Don't use Warm Ember as a second primary -- it's a rare spark, not a co-equal action color.
Don't add a box-shadow to a frosted (surface/Card) panel -- make it a flat card-surface or a true floating glass-card instead.
Don't render form inputs below 16px -- it triggers iOS Safari's zoom-on-focus.
Don't invent a new gray/neutral hex for borders or dividers; derive it from --foreground via color-mix.

Don't treat the privacy-preserving copy voice as a components concern -- individual-constraint language is a content rule from PRODUCT.md, not a visual one, but it constrains any new component's default copy.
